Artist / Borboleta Gallery

María Paula Alzate

Her practice explores colour, light and oil paint as living matter, transforming visual experience into a space of memory and movement.

About the artist

Colour that stretches
and transforms.

Colour is at the heart of María Paula Alzate’s ongoing inquiry. Over the last five years, she has explored the relationship between light, what connects us as human beings, and oil paint as ever-living matter: a metaphor for transformation and movement that can be kneaded and stretched. In her work, oil paint evokes life, the passage of time, longevity and death.

Alzate understands colour as a bearer of knowledge and a way to reveal what words cannot always express. Through the subtlety of shades and tonalities, she creates forms, emotions, intentions and textures that invite viewers to find meanings and realities hidden in plain sight.
